about_the_game:
Welcome to Diceville, a city-building strategy game where every roll of the dice can change your destiny!

Inspired by board games, Diceville combines the depth of card-based tactics with the unpredictability of dice rolls — all without the hassle of managing tokens, rules, or math.

Build unique structures from your deck and activate them based on dice results. Some buildings earn you resources, others benefit your rivals, and some offer powerful, game-changing effects.

As the game progresses, upgrade your central HQ to unlock new abilities and paths to victory. The first player to fully upgrade their HQ wins — but getting there means smart planning, timing, and a bit of luck.

Play solo, with friends, or challenge AI in a fast-paced digital take on a tabletop classic!

🏗️ Features:

  • 🎲 Dice-driven mechanics with deep card-based strategy

  • 🏙️ Build and expand your city with unique structures

  • ♟️ Turn-based gameplay — plan every move carefully

  • 🔧 Upgrade your HQ to unlock powerful new abilities

  • 👥 Multiplayer on a single device (2–4 players)

  • 🤖 AI opponents (in development)

  • 🌐 Languages: English and Russian (more to come!)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd gen) or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / Radeon R7 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (4th gen) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / Radeon RX 550 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Build your city, roll the dice, and outplay your rivals in Diceville — a card-based strategy game inspired by tabletop classics. Trigger building effects, upgrade your HQ, and race to victory in a game of luck, planning, and clever combos.
